question: Can chemical sensing reduce the cycle amplitude of RIAL release by1%,2%,5%, while preserving unpaced body gait, baseline RIAL rhythm and post-cue recovery?
initialization: Fresh CMA at pinned E085 selected failed behavioral candidate; complete original-anchor offsets reconstructed and model/pair reference hashes verified. Not exact optimizer resume or qualified start/stop parent. Independent E071/E078 parents retained.
method: Reuse full302-neuron embodied water model and original chemical schedules. Change fitting objective from body amplitude to RIAL release raw-supported median up/down cycle excursion. Standard deviation/mean remain descriptive; phase shift alone cannot satisfy amplitude gate. Protocols nominal,low-dose,shift,repeat,close-repeat,long-cue unchanged.
trainable: Explicit E085 AWA/AIY/AIZ/AIB/RIA inward/outward nonleak channel density groups and existing source-to-relay/RIAL chemical groups; actual full mapping saved before fitting.
fixed: Motor channels, RIAL-to-SMD strengths, all gaps, other parameters, leak/capacitance/kinetics/reversals/release law, sensory gains/signs/kinetics/routing, NMJs, muscles, physical water/body parameters and clocks. No added edges, external oscillatory drive, clamps or direct body-output gates during training.
bounds: Fresh local group changes within+-0.4log from E085 selected, intersected with unchanged original-anchor factor2 bounds. This recenters the trust region; it is not exact continuation of old local bounds or optimizer.

criteria.neural: Cue/no-cue RIAL release cycle-excursion ratio<=1-target on all eight final normal paired cases; train toward1-1.3*target. All no-cue windows within90..110% parent baseline release excursion and >=.01 absolute release excursion. Cue baseline/recovery within90..110% matched no-cue.
criteria.body: Preserve original E085 regional amplitude gates: baseline90..110% and.003rad floor; useful cue movement50..110%. Absolute frequency1.62..1.98Hz and within5% reference unchanged. Prospective parabolic subsample median-period estimator replaces sampled peak time; old E085 results not rewritten.
criteria.selection: Advance after same-model low-dose/shift checks, preserve each passing rung; final highest passing rung preferred over later unvalidated weights. Raw/body response ratios retained separately; neural component does not qualify body slowing.
criteria.controls: No-cue, chemical-sensory-blocked, varied/repeated/close-repeat cues, long-cue, neural-half/body-half. Final RIAL-to-SMD replay is diagnostic only and measures downstream body response, not required for neural modulation component. No clamps in normal trials.
criteria.numerical: Refined neural response ratio differences<=min(.005,.25target), with all body/neural preservation gates. A strict neural-half frequency failure remains a failed gate; ceiling is not widened.
criteria.claim: Only partial sensory-to-RIAL modulation component. Full sensory initiation/rest/stop/restart, swimming, navigation and biological fidelity remain unqualified. H1.2 downstream behavior training remains gated.
